notes.title: Weekly report for MonGirl Conquest v0.7
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]Artists started working on their tasks. So far, we plan to introduce 2 or 3 new scenes in v0.7, based on how well the artists will handle their workload. Let’s start with the biggest one – jackal mommy will get her fan service story soon. Depending on the drawing progress, it will be added either in the next update or v0.7.5. As for the standard scenes, lynx mommy gets a titfuck scene. Young cheetah gets a missionary scene. Based on how well it goes, the artist may be able to make another one, but we’ll have to wait and see. Anyway, stay tuned for previews![/p][p]I’m focusing on the main quest for now. After Solomon accused you of a crime, there’s no way out of this new mess. Still, you didn’t even know about the temple. So, it can’t be you, right? The new step in the main quest will add a bit of detective and court action to the story. I’ll see the first court meeting and learn about the core of the issue in the temple. This is the last hurdle on your way to getting the snow tribe as an ally. You can’t back out now![/p][p]Aside from this, there’s nothing to report since I did a lot of management tasks, real-life stuff, and the rest went to writing the narrative part for the main quest.[/p][p]Don’t forget to participate in the polls. We have 2 of these going on right now. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/titwolfs-fan-139031760"]One for the fan service mini-story as a whole[/url]. And [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/titwolfs-special-139031766"]another one for the experimental H scene style narration that I used in titwolf’s H scene[/url] for her fan service story. Based on your feedback, I’ll adjust the next fan service content pack. The next one will be for jackal mommy.[/p][p] [/p][p]As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like it – tell your friends ^^[/p]

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.6.5 is up for download!
notes.notes: [p]Mongirl Conquest v0.6.5 is up for download! The competition with Solomon is over. Can you get a happy end with Mila and her tribe? See for yourself![/p][p][b]H content[/b][/p][p]MonGirl Conquest v0.6 has 4 new scenes. Well, almost... I’ll get to it. Bunny mommy got a new type of scene – reverse cowgirl. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/bunny-mommys-138822375"]You can check it out here[/url]. It comes with 3 phases and will be added for other girls later. Young butterfly gets a missionary scene. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/wip-preview-for-138430862"]You can check it out here[/url]. Titwolf mommy gets a cowgirl scene as a part of her fan service mini-story and Eve’s quest line. The scene got both “animation only” and narrative options. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/titwolfs-special-137022132"]You can check it out here[/url].[/p][p]And the last one is Cordelia’s anal scene. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/wip-preview-for-138430846"]You can check it out here[/url]. It was prepared as a part of the new step in her quest line, but the original author became too busy with real-life stuff. So, her update should arrive later. Meanwhile, in order not to waste a prepared scene, I decided to add it to the game. The only way to unlock it at the moment is with the gallery code, though. So, you can say that it’s patron-exclusive until Cordelia gets her next expansion.[/p][p]As always, if you already seduced the girl, the new scenes will be available from the evening date menu. Otherwise, you’ll need to find and seduce the girl in explorable zones.[/p][p][b]New features and activities[/b][/p][p]Let’s see what the new step in the main quest brings. After the conclusion of Yoshi’s competition, it’s time to finish the deal with the snow tribe and Mila the shaman. She’s pretty happy with the results and almost ready to name you the friend of the tribe. Almost. You’ll just need to finish a small ritual. Namely, climb the sacred mountain to the top to become one with the land. Should be easy, right? Just don't forget your warm clothes![/p][p]Eve’s side quest got an update. You’ll stage the first show in v0.6.5 and get a happy bonus for our woof mommy along with some revelations about her feelings. Along with a steamy narrative scene. I’ve tried an experimental style with more direct speech and less action descriptions. The plan is to make a feedback poll after the public release of v0.6.5 before going for the second fan service story with jackal mommy. The polls will still be active shortly after the release (should be around the 16th), so stay tuned to vote for your favorites.[/p][p]The third “fan service mini-story” poll has ended. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/fan-service-poll-138433576"]You can see the detailed results here[/url]. For the short version, polar wolf mommy wins this one. Across all 3 fan service polls, woof girls are the favorite pick... Pack behavior, I guess? Anyway, fan service polls will be on pause until we collect feedback on titwolf’s mini-story and implement new content for mommy jackal and polar wolf mommy. Thanks for participation![/p][p]Added gallery “by girl” sorting. Instead of using the chronological order, all scenes are now grouped by the girl who has them. Girls are introduced roughly in the order they appeared in the game. Story/named characters are added after the common girls for the zone they are introduced in. Hope this helps with finding the missing scenes. I plan to maintain this order from now on, so you can expect the same gallery structure in future updates.[/p][p]Added a new partnership upgrade for the snow tribe to the quartermaster’s shop along with adjusting some others. The new upgrade will provide you with iron ore and icesteel chunks. Could be handy if you want to get the latest upgrades from the smithy.[/p][p][b]Small fixes and improvements[/b][/p][p]Fixed a bug with Yoshi’s cave puzzle. This one is already hotfixed in the current active version. Make sure that you are using the latest one if you downloaded the game earlier.[/p][p]Fixed a bug with “animation only” flag that could trigger an unintended scene choice in some circumstances. Now, all scenes should activate correct variations and not affect each other.[/p][p]Fixed a naming issue for Leopold and his brother along with some other typos. They exchanged their names at one point in the story, and I didn’t notice it immediately.[/p][p]Added an anal H scene option to the test event for the alternative seduction with our young bear. Now, she has the same H scene list for all encounters.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^[/p]

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.6 is up for download!
notes.notes: [p]Mongirl Conquest v0.6 is up for download! The competition with Solomon is coming to a close. How will it end? See for yourself in the next upgrade![/p][p][b]H content[/b][/p][p]MonGirl Conquest v0.6 has 3 new scenes. Snow hare mommy got a cowgirl scene. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/snow-hare-mommy-135003770"]You can check it out here[/url]. Young snow owl gets a missionary scene. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/young-snow-owls-136244735"]You can check it out here[/url]. Earth elemental mommy got an anal scene. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/earth-elemental-136028517"]You can check it out here[/url].[/p][p]As always, if you already seduced the girl, the new scenes will be available from the evening date menu. Otherwise, you’ll need to find and seduce the girl in explorable zones.[/p][p][b]New features and activities[/b][/p][p]The main quest will feature the end for the current mini-arc with Yoshi and the competition. So far, you did your best – will it be enough? Will Yoshi return, or will the mischievous furball leave you for good? See for yourself in this update![/p][p]Cordelia’s optional adventure gets a big update. It brings a new step in the story and a new puzzle, plus enchanted shell upgrades and their own skills. That’s right, we are expanding skill learning to charms too. Cordelia’s shells will be the first batch. Skills will feature stuff connected to special characters from mermaid history and use already familiar learning mechanics though encounters. You’ll also be able to swap between the three shells—at a price, of course.[/p][p]Added a new clothes set for mages with a support “Meditation” skills. To get it, just follow the main quest.[/p][p]The second “fan service mini-story” poll has ended. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/fan-service-poll-134268983"]You can see the detailed results here[/url]. Jackal mommy won with a big lead. She will be the second girl to get her fan service mini-story.[/p][p]Sadly, I fell ill during the last week and didn’t manage to finalize titwolf’s fan story. Sorry about that. Since all the elements are already done, it will be the first thing on the “to do” list for the next update, so it’s guaranteed to release in MonGirl Conquest v0.6.5. It will bring a small story and cowgirl scene for both a normal scene and a special one where Titwolf will wear her costume from the fan story.[/p][p]I plan to make a new feedback poll for the feature to see if the players are interested in it. Right now, the gallery has all H scenes in the order that they were added into the game. So, it may feel kinda random. I want to see if the players would like to see a more grouped-up structure. There are several ways to do this. For example, either group H scenes by girls or by scene types. The first option will have all the scenes of a specific girl grouped together in one place. The second option will have all H scene types in separate groups, regardless of girls. The feedback poll should be up around August 16th-17th if all goes well with the release.[/p][p][b]Small fixes and improvements[/b][/p][p]Adjusted background for snow missionary scene. Changed cowgirl scene background for evening dates to a new one.[/p][p]Fixed some info pop-ups for skill/item leveling. Mainly fixed typos and wrong item icons.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that started a mini-scene at home that you already saw.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^[/p]

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.5.5 is live!
notes.notes: [p]Mongirl Conquest v0.5.5 is up for download! Yoshi dragged you into a competition that you may not win... Still, you should do your best while you can! Perhaps there’s still a chance to win?[/p][p][b]H content[/b][/p][p]MonGirl Conquest v0.5.5 has 3 new scenes. Polar fox mommy got a paizuri scene. [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/snow-fox-mommys-133969412"]You can check it out here[/url]. Snow leopard gets two scenes this time. Namely, we added [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/snow-leopard-133969406"]cowgirl/rider[/url] and [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/snow-leopard-133265343"]anal scenes[/url] for her. As always, if you already seduced the girl, the new scenes will be available from the evening date menu. Otherwise, you’ll need to find and seduce the girl first.[/p][p][b]New features and activities[/b][/p][p]The main story update will be focused on preparing for the showdown with Yoshi’s quartz scheme. Plus, she couldn’t be serious about leaving you, right? Right? Well, you better do your best while she’s away![/p][p]Added “salvager team” feature to quartermaster’s camp upgrades. You’ll need to progress the main story far enough for it to appear. Once bought, you’ll see a new vendor close to the quartermaster himself. The new character will allow you to buy missed special items. The cost will be quite high, so don’t forget to explore new zones on your own! After all, it’s the best way to get the interesting stuff! I’ll keep updating the goods list for the salvager team if new items that you can miss will be added to the game.[/p][p]Added another cute mini-scene. This time you’ll see Cleo and Catarina doing some cooking for special someone. Can two big cats master the pot? Check it out yourself! As usual, to trigger the scene, you should go to sleep in your upgraded home. Though there are other options to trigger mini-scenes too, but this is the main one.[/p][p]Aside from this, I did some tech stuff optimization before the release. It’s about preventing scenes starting together and causing problems like that case with werewolf’s ear animation. You can think about that as a screw-up safety net that won’t allow animation bug to crash the game. Still, if you get any kind of errors or weird behavior – don’t hesitate to report it to me![/p][p]Our first “fan service mini-story” poll has ended. So, she will be the first girl to get her fan service mini-story. I’m not sure when this will happen, but the estimated range is either the v0.6 update or the next one after that. Since it’s a new element, we want to make it fitting both for the girl and the overall story. Meanwhile, we’ll proceed with such polls. The winners will go into the queue, exactly like we already did with the “new girl” poll series.[/p][p][b]Small fixes and improvements[/b][/p][p]Fixed a bug that prevented snow wolf mommy to use her tail in the cowgirl/rider scene.[/p][p]Slimmed up texture atlases for some scenes. This should help with loading times and overall smoothness during scene phase transitions on weaker devices.[/p][p]Fixed a bug that allowed the clear percent to go over 100% in the statistics window from the save menu.[/p][p] [/p][p]As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^[/p]

Aside from this, Cordelia’s quest original author finished the narrative part for Cordelia’s titfuck scene. It started out as animation only, but v0.3.5 will introduce the narrative part. If you already finished the current step in her quest, you can check out the new narrative option for her scene via the gallery.

The new seduction event for young bear is mostly done from the logic perspective. It’s already in the game as a test event, but we need to polish the animations via the artist who worked with it. Since he’s on the new girl + her scene, this became a bottleneck for rolling it out. But it should appear in the upcoming update since the artist will start working on the fix before his new scene art pack.

Some players asked about the bar character sprites, and why there are no new additions. That’s because there’s a finite space for images swaps for all events and we hit that limit. At the moment, there’s no way to add another pack of sprites for new girls. I’m not sure if there’s a proper way to extend the limit, so we’ll need to sidestep this issue in the future after inventing a way to do this.

[b]Small fixes and improvements[/b]

Improved titfuck scene finishing animation for all girls who have this type of scene.

Fixed a bug that counted Earth elemental mommy as a rare girl for exploration quests if the player used a master gem to skip the seduction minigame.

Fixed some typos and inconsistences in dialogues.

Changed activation lines for Cordelia’s skills in the combo adventure with her.

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.3 is live!
notes.notes:
Mongirl Conquest v0.3 is up for download! This time, you will set foot on the new island and try to contact the biggest local tribe. How it’ll go? Let’s see what’s new aside from the usual story update.

[b]H content[/b]

MonGirl Conquest v0.3 has 3 new scenes. Young fennec gets her new missionary scene. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/fennecs-new-h-122134074]You can check it out in this post[/url]. New girl, polar wolf mommy, gets her first H scene - cowgirl. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/polar-wolf-h-122134080]Here’s the preview[/url]. Another new girl, earth elemental mommy, gets a missionary scene. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/earth-elementals-122200838]Here’s the preview[/url].

You can encounter earth elemental and polar wolf in the new, snowy exploration zone. Fennec can be encountered both in desert and snowy zones. Some girls will have to act as stand-ins until we’ll get enough new girls to fully populate the new exploration area. I’ll gradually phase out these stand-ins with each upcoming update and new girl.

[b]New features and activities[/b]

Three new girls arrive in v0.3 version. You can check out polar wolf mommy [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/polar-woof-mommy-121799681]here[/url]. Earth elemental mommy awaits you [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/earth-elementals-116760887]here[/url]. And the young polar fox hides [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/young-polar-fox-121272259]here[/url]. First two can be encountered in the new exploration zone, while Mila the cute fox is a new plot character.

Added a new exploration zone. This time, it’s a pretty cold place. So, don’t forget to get some warm clothes. Otherwise, some encounter effects will have a stronger effect on you. Also, the snowy exploration zone is a bit different from the previous ones graphics-wise. It’s more about quality of life changes, like swapping active blinking markers from yellow-white to red-ish colors. Otherwise, these are hard to see on the snowy landscape. Plus, the “islands” you explore use different types of terrain and encounter backgrounds. Based on your feedback, I’m open to fine-tuning these elements.

Added a pair of new weapons to the smithy in your camp for fighters and mages. It’s a part of an already existing smithy upgrade that you could buy a bit earlier, so you don’t need to visit the quartermaster. Though, these new weapons will require a new material from the snow exploration zone.

Added two new weapons (one for mages and one for hunters) to the snowy zone hunter’s altar. You can buy them with shards you get for completing the dynamic quests during exploration. Fighter’s weapon allows 2 basic attacks during a turn. Mage’s weapon offers solid mana regen.

[b]Small fixes and improvements[/b]

Changed the look of the seduction bar during seduction encounters or dates. Now, it has a proper sprite assigned instead of a basic bar.

Fixed a problem that prevented some girls from playing the stripping animation effect during their “phase” transitions in encounters.

Optimized the loading for some H scenes. Hopefully, this will help with loading times on weaker devices.

Fixed a few typos here and there based on player feedback.

Fixed a visual bug that shown an incorrect amount of unlocked scenes in the gallery. This doesn’t affect your H scenes, just save information on the loading screen.

Fixed a bug that prevented passive camp upgrades from providing materials.

Fixed a bug that caused loading for graphical assets to hang and just keep the “loading” picture over everything else in the evening dates.

Fixed a rare bug that caused a black screen after a scene to remain there indefinitely.

Fixed a bug that caused a background to be placed on a wrong layer, hiding the H scene behind the backdrop in some scenarios.


As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^

The rest of the time will be devoted to new combat and seduction encounters + the old idea about seduction encounter alternative. I made a [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/120890114]feedback poll about duo quests like we had with Cordelia the mermaid[/url]. It’s out for quite a bit, so I decided to see what players think about this format. Don’t be shy to share your thoughts!

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.2.8 release and full changelog
notes.notes:
Mongirl Conquest v0.2.8 is up for download! Queen Adia wants to hold a special lesson for you and she won’t take no for an answer. Let’s see what’s new aside from the usual story update.

[b]H content[/b]

MonGirl Conquest v0.2.8 has 3 new scenes. Tongue-twister gets her new missionary. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/tongue-twisters-117448263]You can check it out in this post[/url]. Queen Adia get her new cowgirl H scene. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/117762527]Here’s the preview[/url]. And finally, Cordelia gets her titfuck/paizuri scene. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/117889146]You can see it here[/url].

Cordelia’s scene posed a new kind of challenge with the dynamic background since she’s a mermaid, and we can’t just pull her out completely from the water. At least not now. Plus we decided to test out an idle “after scene” animation. This puts extra strain on the animation plugin, but test runs gave us no problems on different hardware and software combos we had available. Still, if you encounter performance issues during her scene – contact me with details via yeehawgames@gmail.com.

Also, Cordelia’s scene will start out as animation only and will get the narrative variation later. Her original author didn’t have the time to finish the text part for the scene before the release date, but you can expect it to pop up in the next one.

[b]New features and activities[/b]

Cordelia gets the third step in seaside cave journey with some optional content. This time you’ll get to fight along the mermaid. Thankfully, her water magic is just the thing you need to overcome all problems and get the ultimate reward – mermtits! I mean you’ll get a choice of several magic items too, but we all know why we are helping the fishy.

There’s an optional branch with a puzzle and special combat encounter for 100% clear fans. You don’t need to rush it in one go, though. You can return to this cave after leaving by interacting with Cordelia’s usual spot during evening. So, take it in your own pace.

A new girl joins the cast. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/earth-elementals-116760887]Namely, earth elemental[/url]. She won’t appear immediately, but in the new winter zone that will be open for exploration in the next update.

Added a new set of clothes with defensive skill that improves both normal and magical defense at the same time. If you have trouble figuring out boss patterns (like with the golem), it will help to mitigate incoming damage.

Added a new sound pack for titfuck scenes. After some polishing and playtesting, it will be in all titfuck encounters in the game instead of the placeholder for doggy/missionary sex. It includes a new ending sequence too.

[b]Small fixes and improvements[/b]

Fixed a specific error if the player tried to exit the desktop version of the game via the main menu.
Some minor spelling corrections for dialogues and journal entries.

Fixed a bug that displayed a black screen instead of a scene in some cases when you started them in your house via evening dates. If you still get this effect – contact me with details.
Adjusted some map geometry to improve character pathing.

Fixed a possibility for Queen Adia’s titfuck scene to loop around for the second playthrough instead of ending properly.

As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^
